built: Benchmark design (docs/vision/BENCHMARK.json) and a pure scorer over scoped views. score_view(big, scope, gold_case) scores view(big, scope) per element type (reactions, enzymes, transports, interactions, compartments): recall always, precision only for types the case declares complete, extension-row precision, recovered_by_extension, and a provenance-kind breakdown ('primary' partitions the predicted elements, 'any' counts every kind an element carries). run_benchmark(cases, {case: {run: big}}, scope) gives legs plus a micro aggregate per case kind (paper and full never pooled). Gold builders: gold_from_supplement (paper kind, from gold_v2 / paper_gold supplements), gold_from_pathbank (full kind, from a pathbank_gold.extract payload, no I/O), build_full_gold (accession -> extract through an injectable extractor; the only DB read). Matching reuses eval_v2: match_reaction, _row_key, matcher.strict/candidate/enzyme keys, plus an identifier bridge over payload.grounded_ids.
